data.title: 三司绫濑 · 后台的一束花
data.description: 后台桌上放着一束刚送来的花。绫濑拿起卡片读完，将它仔细塞回花束的包装纸里。
data.action: reading a card beside a bouquet
data.promptProse: In the cozy clutter of a backstage green room, Ayase leans against a makeup-laden table, reading an elegant congratulatory greeting card extracted from a lush arrangement of fresh lilies and roses. Soft, theatrical vanity lighting casts a warm glow over her expressive eyes and glossy performance costume, while stage curtains and garment racks frame the lively background.
